english.name: Purple Heart
english.description: Awarded to those wounded or killed while serving

schinese.name: 紫心勋章
schinese.description: 授予在执勤中受伤或牺牲者

schinese.name: 功绩服务勋章
schinese.description: 因长期服务而授予（30 次勤务）

english.name: Medal of Valor
english.description: Awarded for finishing 3 duties in a row without any death or major mistakes (less than -3 reputation)

schinese.name: 英勇勋章
schinese.description: 因连续完成 3 次勤务且无死亡或重大失误而授予（声望损失少于 3）

english.name: Community Policing Medal
english.description: Awarded for gaining 100 reputation points on one duty

schinese.name: 社区警务勋章
schinese.description: 因在一次勤务中获得 100 点声望而授予

english.name: Lifesaving Medal
english.description: Awarded for saving a life by giving proper first aid instructions

schinese.name: 救生勋章
schinese.description: 因通过正确急救指导挽救生命而授予

english.name: Safe Driving Medal
english.description: Awarded for keeping the roads safe (Resolve 50 driving reports)

schinese.name: 安全驾驶勋章
schinese.description: 因维护道路安全而授予（处理 50 起驾驶相关报告）

english.name: Tactical Squad Service Medal
english.description: Awarded for special tactical skills (gather 3 police teams before shooting starts)

schinese.name: 战术小队服务勋章
schinese.description: 因特殊战术能力而授予（枪击开始前集结 3 支警队）

english.name: Advanced Certification Medal
english.description: Awarded for reaching high experience level (any team member)

schinese.name: 高级认证勋章
schinese.description: 因任意队员达到高经验等级而授予

english.name: Sacrifice Medal
english.description: Awarded for resolving a case despite death of your team member

schinese.name: 牺牲勋章
schinese.description: 因在队员死亡的情况下仍解决案件而授予

english.name: Order of Smile
english.description: Awarded for a sense of humor ;)

english.name: Exemplary Medical Service Medal
english.description: Awarded for saving 50 people by driving them to a hospital.

schinese.name: 模范医疗服务勋章
schinese.description: 因将 50 人送往医院获救而授予。

english.name: Exemplary Fire Service Medal
english.description: Awarded for resolving 50 fire or technical cases.

schinese.name: 模范消防服务勋章
schinese.description: 因处理 50 起火灾或技术案件而授予。

english.name: International Service Medal
english.description: Awarded for working in 15 different cities.

schinese.name: 国际服务勋章
schinese.description: 因在 15 个不同城市工作而授予。

english.name: Above and Beyond
english.description: Complete the game on Expert difficulty

english.name: Perfect Time Manager
english.description: Complete a duty without overtime on Hard/Expert difficulty

schinese.name: 完美时间管理者
schinese.description: 在困难/专家难度无加班完成一次勤务
